description:
Host a remote image URL on SpiderPublish's R2 and get back a hosted, allowlisted URL.

Use this when you have an image URL (e.g. a generated hero on a provider host
like kie.*) that you want to use as a blog post cover_image_url or a page image
block. createPost / page image fields only accept a small host allowlist
(media.cdn.spideriq.ai + a few stock CDNs); a raw generation-host URL is
REJECTED. Call this first to mirror the image onto R2, then pass the returned
`media.r2_url` to content_create_post({ cover_image_url }).

JSON-only — no file upload needed (unlike upload_local_file). The server fetches
the URL server-side (SSRF-guarded, 5 MB cap, images only) and transcodes to WebP.

Returns { success, media: { r2_url, ... }, asset }. A bad/unreachable URL or
non-image body is an error; oversized (>5 MB) is rejected.

alt_text.description: Alt text for accessibility (stored on the media record).

media_url.description: The remote image URL to fetch and host (https/http). Any public host is accepted.

project.description: Optional project — a website inside the workspace (proj_xxx) — to scope this call to. Sent as the X-Project-Id header. If omitted, the spideriq.json / SPIDERIQ_PROJECT_ID binding (or the workspace default project) is used.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: media_ingest_url
